ParishionerProfile.title: ParishionerProfile
ParishionerProfile.description: Authenticated parishioner record for St. Anthony's Church, Ajni, linked with Google Sign-In and optional Parish Registry ID.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the parishioner.

parishId.description: Optional church registry or family card ID.

sccUnit.description: Small Christian Community (SCC) or parish ward unit.

websiteSyncStatus.description: Synchronization status with the parish website REST API bridge.

CertificateRequest.title: CertificateRequest
CertificateRequest.description: Sacramental certificate request submitted by a parishioner (Birth, Communion, Confirmation, Marriage, or Death).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting parishioner.

applicantName.description: Name of person submitting the request.

subjectName.description: Full name on the requested certificate.

eventDate.description: Date of birth, sacrament, marriage, or passing.

placeOrParish.description: Hospital, chapel, or parish where event occurred.

sponsorOrNextOfKin.description: Sponsor, godparent, or next of kin.

registryReference.description: Optional register book or parish ID reference.

notes.description: Additional instructions for the parish office.

websiteSyncStatus.description: Synchronization status with the parish website REST API bridge.

/users/{userId}.description: Private parishioner profile document owned exclusively by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/certificate_requests/{re.description: Sacramental certificate requests owned by the authenticated parishioner.
